title: Wholesome Indian Lemongrass-Takrai Dal
description: A delicious and nourishing solo-dinner featuring lemongrass-takrai in a satvik-friendly dal. Perfect for a weeknight dinner.

ingredients.name: Split Red Lentils (Masoor Dal)
ingredients.notes: Rinse and soak overnight, then drain and use

ingredients.name: Lemongrass-Takrai Paste
ingredients.notes: Make or buy the lemongrass-takrai paste according to the recipe

instructions: Heat ghee or oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until soft and translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the diced tomato and cook until it starts to break down.
Add the split red lentils, lemongrass-takrai paste, salt, turmeric, cumin powder, and coriander powder. Mix well.
Add 4 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover the saucepan with a lid, and let the dal simmer for 20 minutes.
Check the lentils for doneness. They should be tender and mushy.
Stir in some chopped fresh cilantro for garnish.
Serve hot with steamed rice or roti.
